<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog for reactions where a ketone functional group is broken (as in the Wolff‑Kishner reduction). I’ll use a simple molecule (methane) as the target SMILES just to query the database, and filter by the broken functional group “ketone”. This should return the template ID and its SMARTS, from which I can later obtain the mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone"],
    "functional_groups_formed": null,
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "bonds_order_changed": null,
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
